sc: The to do' list is a quest item obtained during the Grim Tales quest.
It is obtained by playing the tune written on a music sheet on the piano in the basement of the witch's house in Taverley.
It was made by combining a blue charm with 144 spirit shards and Adamant bar.

Spirit gems, which are dropped by all monsters that drop a single charm and could be received from the Squeal of Fortune, functioned similarly to Runecrafting pouches and stored uncharged summoning pouches before an update.
The Armadyl chainskirt is a reward from the God Wars Dungeon.
The barrows-dyed Ascension crossbow is made by dyeing an Ascension crossbow with Barrows dye.
It can be obtained as a 1/65 drop from hunting asciatops in Big Game Hunter, or from purchasing a dinosaur egg from Irwinsson's Hunter Mark Shop for 80 hunter marks (1/13 chance).
The augmented arcane spirit shield is a level 75 Magic off-hand slot item created by using an augmentor on an arcane spirit shield.
The augmented Death Lotus chestplate is a level 85 Ranged torso slot item created by using an augmentor on a superior death lotus chestplate.
It may also be made by augmenting a pair of elite sirenic chaps (Aurora) at an inventor's workbench.
Alternatively, it may be created by upgrading a pair of augmented sirenic chaps (Aurora).
The augmented farseer kiteshield is a level 80 Magic off-hand slot item created by using an augmentor on a farseer kiteshield.

The shadow-dyed augmented sirenic hauberk is level 90 Ranged torso slot power armour, created by using an augmentor and divine charges on a sirenic hauberk (shadow), or by using shadow dye on an augmented sirenic hauberk.

Battle Robes (Fumus) Gloves.x: Battle Robes (Fumus) Gloves is a hands slot cosmetic override that is part of the Battle Robes (Fumus) set.

sc: Behemoth notes (part 5) is a drop from the Hope devourer in Daemonheim.
A black knight helm is found on a bookshelf in the Sinclair Mansion.

The chance of successfully crafting the blank rune depends on your Crafting level. It does not matter if rune or pure essence is used.
sc: It is made by using a chisel on a normal rune essence or pure essence after adding the missing Page 1, Page 2 and Page 3 back into Maledict's holy book.
The blightleaf hood is an item that can only be obtained and used while training Dungeoneering inside Daemonheim.
It may be picked up from the table at the beginning of a dungeon, obtained as a monster drop, or produced using the Crafting skill.

s: Ani's Seed Store by the Sea Shore
sc: These seeds may be obtained by planting a fireberry seed and a rumberry seed next to each other and foraging from one of the resulting bushes, or by foraging from a blisterberry bush.
Blue goblin mail is made by using blue dye on goblin mail.

While wearing blue goblin mail the player can enter the Ekeleshuun goblin tribe's area and pickpocket the Ekeleshuun priest to obtain the Ekeleshuun key (Land of the Goblins) required to continue the quest.
Boat materials are quest items found by scavenging piles of debris in the Scabarite Cavern during the Beneath Scabaras' Sands quest.
A total of five piles need to be scavenged to obtain enough materials to repair the broken boat by the river, allowing the player to then sail to the Temple of Isolation.
The bold tattoo is a cosmetic headgear that could only be obtained from playing the Squeal of Fortune.

u: Bowl of milk, honey and guam
sc: The item is made by using a special bowl with the beehive in the backyard to obtain a bowl of honey.
Players must then add a bucket of milk, found in the side table, to make it into a bowl of milk and honey.

Bubbles (Underwater disguise kit).x: Bubbles are an item automatically equipped when diving underwater on Tutorial Island and using an underwater disguise kit. Attempting to unequip the bubbles will give the message "You can't unequip bubbles, you're underwater!".

sc: Butterfly nets can be picked up from a spawn in the home of Raz in Havenhythe, or purchased at low prices from the Hunter shops in Taverley, Yanille, Nardah, Anachronia, and Hollow Hill, or the Rellekka and Feldip Hills hunter areas for 24 coins.
They may also be obtained through the hunter kit, which is obtained using a level 71 spell in the Lunar Spellbook.
The charming potion is a potion that increases the base number of charms dropped by a monster by 1 for 6 minutes.
However, it does not affect charms obtained from non-combat sources, such as hunting charming moths or pickpocketing Amlodd workers.
Clue scroll (easy) is a simple clue obtained from easy sealed clue scrolls.
It is found by killing the armoured zombie outside the main entrance.
Commander Porkins is a flying pig companion pet that can be purchased for 1 premier reward token from the Premier Token Store.
It could originally be unlocked by purchasing the Silver or Gold Premier Club in 2014.
Commorb is a members-only quest item obtained during the Wanted! quest from Sir Tiffy Cashien.

Corrupted slayer helmet (f) (green).x: Corrupted slayer helmet (f) (green) is a corrupted slayer helmet with a ferocious ring infused and coloured green. The helm can hold a maximum of 30 ferocious ring charges and 40 ring of slaying charges, made by using the rings on the helmet and requiring 60 Crafting.

sc: They cannot be crafted from mystic cloth unlike the standard blue variant, and are only available as a rare drop from Infernal Mages.

Deadly Highwayman's Outfit (Master) is a cosmetic override outfit that can be unlocked by redeeming a Deadly Highwayman's Outfit (Master) token or by purchasing it from the Marketplace at a price of 700 RuneCoins for free-to-play players and 630 RuneCoins for members.
It was originally obtained through the Assassin's Return promotion on Treasure Hunter.
The Death Lotus Disciple Mask is a head slot item which can be obtained from completing tasks during the Death Lotus Training event.
It could formerly be purchased for 600 oddments from the Oddments Store.
A deathsalve robe top is tier 1 necromancy tank body armour available in Daemonheim as part of the deathsalve armour set.
It is made from ensouled salve cloth and ensouled thread with level 8 Crafting.
It is made by using two soft clay on a potter's wheel, requiring 79 Crafting and giving 51 experience.

r: Divine Moon Guard and Lantern override token
Divine Moon Guard and Lantern override token
sc: Divine Moon Lantern is an off-hand necromancy weapon cosmetic override that is unlocked by redeeming a Divine Moon Guard and Lantern override token.
It is obtained by searching a chest in the witch's house deep in the dungeon west of West Ardougne.
The doll is turned into an effigy of Iban by using Iban's shadow, Iban's ashes, Iban's blood and Iban's dove, all of which have to be obtained by completing various tasks in the dungeon, on it.
It is a 1/500 drop from hunting draconic jadinkos.
It is also obtainable from training at one of the skilling stations in the Dream of Iaia.

q: Ability to wield a dragon square shield
sc: The dragon square shield is created by combining the shield left half, a very rare drop from a wide variety of monsters, and the shield right half, which must be purchased from Siegfried Erkle in the Legends' Guild for 750,000 coins.
With the release of PvP worlds on 15 October 2008, players began obtaining whole dragon square shields as drops from other players killed on these worlds.

Although it could presumably be used to unlock the Duskrunner's Blade and Duskrunner's Blade Off-hand cosmetic overrides, these are instead unlocked by using 50 Treasure Hunter Keys during the promotion.
A dwarven black diamond could be obtained when wearing the Jewelled black iron ring during the Mine Blowing promotion.
It is created by using the emerald lens with a bullseye lantern (frame).
It is similar to the sapphire lantern, but unlike the sapphire lantern it is not made using a cut gem.

Partial completion of Secrets of Amberfell
sc: It can be created after the quest, but it can't be used, banked, or disassembled.
It is a possible reward from reward casket (hard).
It is possible to obtain another enhanced yaktwee stick by talking to Yaktwee with a regular stick even if you already have an enhanced yaktwee stick in your inventory.
Enhanced yaktwee stick.x: An enhanced yaktwee stick is an upgraded version of the yaktwee stick, and is obtained by catching a total of 1,000 charm sprites with the yaktwee stick equipped and talking to Yaktwee Swinmari Cianta. sc: Fenrir's tooth is an item dropped by the wolf Fenrir during the winter event from 2016 onwards.
Festive Snowglobe Lantern is an off-hand necromancy weapon cosmetic override that can be purchased for 7,500 Christmas spirit from the Christmas Spirit Shop.
A Fish Flingers scorecard is an item obtainable by talking to a Fisherman and asking him to give you one.
It used to be obtainable from Fisherman's Wife in front of the Fishing Guild.
Fremennik cloaks are capes made by Yrsa.
They can be bought from Yrsa's clothes shop in western Rellekka after completing The Fremennik Trials.
Frost dragon bones are obtained by killing frost dragons in the resource dungeon within the Asgarnian Ice Dungeon, south of Port Sarim.

A player choosing to use frost dragon bones all the way from 1-99 Prayer, using a gilded altar with lit burners and no other experience boosts, would, if all the bones were bought at the current Grand Exchange price, spend .

sc: The Gift of Giving is magical snow mixed with snow imp vomit, and was a reward given to players during A Stray in a Manger after successfully finding all four dogs, adopting one of them, and choosing a home for it in one of four locations.
The Gift of Giving cannot be banked, and the inactive version may be re-obtained from the snow imp if it is lost or destroyed.
Although monkey nuts, purple sweets, oranges and holy biscuits are members items, players could still obtain them from the Gift of Giving on free to play worlds.
Fremennik gloves can be bought from Yrsa's Clothing Shop in Rellekka after completing The Fremennik Trials.
These gloves can also be a drop from Dagannoths in the Waterbirth Dungeon and they can also be obtained from Managing Miscellania by putting workers in the fishing area.
Herald of Fate Book is an off-hand magic weapon cosmetic override that can be purchased for 2 yak coins from the Yak Coin Shop.
It was originally unlocked by completing tier 47 of Yak to the Shadows with the premier pass.
Herald of Fate Orb is an off-hand magic weapon cosmetic override that can be purchased for 2 yak coins from the Yak Coin Shop.
It was originally unlocked by completing tier 49 of Yak to the Shadows.
An igneous geode is a rock sometimes obtained when mining orichalcite, drakolith, necrite, phasmatite, concentrated coal, banite, light animica, dark animica, or primal Mining rocks.
The Incomplete jade idol (with the body and legs) is created by combining a jade idol body and jade idol legs.
They can be made by using 1 iron ore on the smelter.

Lava Wings.x: Lava Wings are a wings slot cosmetic override that can be unlocked as part of the Lava Hood & Wings set. It was originally unlocked by purchasing the 2015 Gold Premier Club package.

sc: The lucky off-hand chaotic crossbow is a piece of lucky equipment that can be won from Treasure Hunter from 13 March 2015 0:00 UTC onwards.
A lunar calendar is a Guthixian artefact that is made by restoring its damaged variant at an archaeologist's workbench.
Mahjarrat's Ritual Chakram is a main hand ranged weapon cosmetic override unlocked by completing tier 42 of The Winter Trials.
Marmaros ore is an ore that can be obtained through mining marmaros rocks, requiring level 100 Mining, in the surface of the Daemonheim peninsula.
A medium crystal urchin can be obtained from Prifddinas Waterfall Fishing with level 95 Fishing for 330 experience.
It was made by upgrading a strong slayer helmet for 600 Slayer points at any Slayer Master, although subsequent upgrades would only cost 60 Slayer points.
The helm could hold a maximum of 30 ferocious ring charges and 40 ring of slaying charges, made by using the rings on the helmet and requiring 60 Crafting.
Nelly is a companion pet that can be purchased for 5 yak coins from the Yak Coin Shop.
It was originally unlocked by completing tier 25 of Yak to the Light with the premier pass and was later available for a time from the Marketplace for 15,000 oddments.
It is obtained by using a vial on the barrel in the northeastern chamber inside the dungeon under the Dig Site.

tx:
▸ Churning butter
Butter can be made from buckets of milk or pots of cream using a dairy churn, and can also be obtained for free from dairy cows if you bring your own buckets. Churning is relatively slow, taking 151 seconds to convert 28 milk to butter.
Churning from milk turns one bucket of milk into an empty bucket and a pat of butter, so if you wish to retain the buckets then only 14 butter can be made in one trip. However when churning milk with a full inventory the empty buckets will fall to the ground, and a full load of butter can be obtained. Since the buckets are obtained for free from the milk sellers, their loss isn't a problem.
Milk can be bought from milk sellers which have a stock of 200 available. There are two milk sellers, one in Sinclair Mansion and one in Falador farm. 28 buckets of milk can be bought from the milk seller in the Sinclair Mansion garden, then use the churn a short distance north. Use the lodestone teleport to return to Seers' Village. A dairy cow is also available at Sinclair Mansion. Falador farm is faster with explorer's ring 3, which is also the only milk seller available in free-to-play. Cabbage port to farm, buy milk from milk seller to the northwest, enter through the door immediately to the south then use the churn in the west room. Teleport to any bank (e.g. War's Retreat Teleport or ring of duelling) to deposit the butter and repeat. Without teleports, banking at Clan Camp is closest. A dairy cow is also available at the farm.
Unlimited buckets of milk can also be obtained from the larder in player-owned houses (however, this is individually taken and click intensive). After obtaining milk, teleport to any dairy churn to make butter, then any bank, then teleport to house to repeat.…
sc: A pat of butter is a food ingredient made with the Cooking skill.
The player-owned house diorama is obtained by opening the housewarming gift after completing There's No Place Like Home.
The housewarming gift is only available from the game update on 13 July 2026 to 13 August 2026.
The portable workbench is a portable skilling station that can be obtained from a portable skilling pack.
Before 6 November 2020, they were exclusively available as a standalone Treasure Hunter prize.
A premade tangled toads' legs (spelled as premade ttl in-game) is a type of gnomish food that can be bought from the gnome waiter in the north-west corner of the of the Grand Tree.

A pride note is an item given by Jagex Moderators to nearby players during the Community Pride 2020 Event on 25 June 2020, the Community Pride on 25 June 2021, the Pride Parades on 24 June 2022, 28 June 2023, 21 June 2024, and during the Community Pride on 11 June 2024.

Raptor (Advanced) Helmet.x: The Raptor (Advanced) Helmet is a head slot cosmetic override that can be obtained by defeating any combination of 50 Wyverns, Ripper Demons, Camel Warriors and Acheron mammoths with the Raptor outfit unlocked.

sc: A raw pheasant was obtained by killing the pheasant which the Freaky Forester asked the player to kill.

Replica Infinity (Water).x: Replica Infinity (Water) is a cosmetic override outfit that is unlocked by purchasing the Replica Infinity Robes pack from Solomon's General Store for 60,000 loyalty points.

Royal dragonhide set.x: Royal dragonhide set is an item obtained by exchanging a set of items with a Grand Exchange clerk via their right-click "Exchange" option, followed by the "Sets" tab and clicking on the appropriate item set within the Item Sets interface.

sc: They can be made at a forge and anvil using 4 rune bars and rune armoured boots + 2, requiring 720 progress to complete, granting a total of 960 Smithing experience.
Silverquill's head is a boss trophy obtained from defeating Silverquill, the Dreadhog.
A Slayer XP lamp is awarded when defeating Glophren.
Smoothed catalysed elemental diamond is an item used in the creation process of the masterwork staff, created by smoothing an catalysed elemental diamond.
It is made by attaching a spectral sigil, a very rare drop from the Corporeal Beast, to a blessed spirit shield.
Splitbark body can be created by giving 4 pieces of bark, 4 pieces of fine cloth, and 37,000 coins to the Wizard Jalarast at the Wizards' Tower.
They can be made by using either 5 steel bars, a steel platebody, or a steel platebody + 1 at a furnace with level 20 Smithing.

r: Partial completion of The Fremennik Trials
sc: They are obtained by giving a fiscal statement to Yrsa in Rellekka.
The stylish glasses (green) are a reward from opening a master reward casket.
Summer sq'irks are obtained through the Sorceress's Garden minigame.
The super prayer potion is a restorative potion which can be made at level 94 Herblore.
It is made from a 3-dose prayer potion and a pot of wyvern bonemeal or ground wyvern bones.
The Magister's Journal #4 is one of the five books dropped by the Magister and other monsters in the Sophanem Slayer Dungeon.
Players do not have to be on a Slayer assignment to obtain this journal.

Tribal shirt (green).x: The green tribal shirt is part of the tribal outfit item set. It gives no bonuses and is a cosmetic item.

sc: An unfinished wooden brooch is an item obtained by chopping regular trees and then carving the wooden knot with a dwarven army axe or a chisel.
The outfit has also been available in the Yak Coin Shop for 6 Yak coins.

Vial of stench (a) (A Guild of Our Own)
Completion of A Guild of Our Own (miniquest)
sc: Vial of stench (a) is an inconsumable potion that can be made after the miniquest A Guild of Our Own.
It is created by having Chief Thief Robin in the Thieves' Guild cast a spell on a vial of stench to activate it.

Wushanko hat (sepia).x: The sepia wushanko hat is part of the wushanko outfit item set. It gives no bonuses and is a cosmetic item.

Yellow partyhat (2018 April Fools).x: Yellow partyhat is an item that can be found on the ground at various locations around Gielinor. When the player attempts to pick one up, they receive a ring of rares instead accompanied with the message: You cast the partyhat aside and pick up a precious ring you find underneath it instead.
